modules.name: Core
modules.description: Shared foundation of the Maxcode range: a single admin tab, this catalogue and the upgrade banner.

modules.name: Admin Theme
modules.description: A polished look for the Magento admin: buttons, borders and separators, plus a configurable logo and favicon.

modules.name: Sitemap Exclude CMS
modules.description: One switch on each CMS page to keep it out of the XML sitemap.

modules.name: Translation Fixes
modules.description: Makes translatable the Magento strings that are not exposed to translation.

modules.name: Tracking Links
modules.description: Sends customers to the carrier's own tracking page from the shipment e-mail and the tracking page, even when the tracking number was typed by hand.

modules.name: Product Question
modules.description: A product page block that sends shoppers to the contact form with the product already mentioned.

modules.name: FAQ
modules.description: One independent FAQ for your store: groups and questions per store view, FAQ page, widget, product, category and CMS blocks, FAQPage markup.

modules.name: Popup
modules.description: An editable welcome popup shown once to each new visitor, with its content in a CMS block per store view.

modules.name: Admin Theme Pro
modules.description: Set the colours, shapes and typography of the Maxcode admin theme from the back office.

modules.name: Product Attachment
modules.description: A document library attached to your products: customer group and store view restrictions, a product tab and secure downloads.

modules.name: Search Relevance
modules.description: Search relevance and analytics: a search layer, search weights, unwanted terms kept out, and a dashboard of what shoppers search for and what finds nothing.

modules.name: AI Assistant
modules.description: An AI shopping assistant that answers shoppers from your catalog, pages and FAQ, with the name and face you choose.
